question: Who among the following authored the 2025 book 'Original Sin'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jake Tapper and Alex Thompson**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The book titled **"Original Sin: Joe Biden and the End of the Democratic Party as We Know It"** was authored by **Jake Tapper** and **Alex Thompson**.
 
• Released in **January 2025**, the book provides a comprehensive, behind-the-scenes account of the **Joe Biden** presidency and the internal turmoil within the **Democratic Party** leading up to the **2024 United States Presidential Election**.
 
• The narrative focuses on the critical period of **2024**, detailing the pressures that led to **President Biden's** decision to withdraw from the race and the subsequent endorsement of Vice President **Kamala Harris**. ***Hence, the statement regarding the authors is correct.***
